caption: The drawing consists of several black line illustrations on a beige or off-white background. On the left side, there is a detailed drawing of a tall grandfather clock with ornate decorative elements at the top, an oval panel on the door, a circular clock face with Roman numerals, and an additional decorative segment at the bottom. Beside it, there are two side profile views of the clock case, one showing the outline and details, the other a simplified silhouette. On the upper right, there are two oval-shaped ornamental panels; the top one contains a stylized eagle with spread wings, a shield on its chest, and a ring of stars above. The lower panel features a decorative urn with handles, holding three flowers. Below these, there are two intricately designed clock hands, one longer and slimmer, the other more ornate and broader. At the bottom right, there is a circular element with a star pattern, trailing two ribbon-like shapes to the right. The composition is arranged with ample spacing and no overlapping objects. The entire image is rendered in monochrome black lines without shading, texture, or additional colors.
title: Clock
